The '''Von-Alai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Locris sector/Legends|Locris sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Von-Alai]].
